title: Chat Translator ALPHA
features:
!!Sorry, everyone. Unfortunately, I do not have access to a proper exploit and will not be spending money on one in the near future. As a result, I am unable to develop any further updates.!!

This Chat Translator script for Roblox allows users to translate chat messages between different languages. Users can enable or disable translations for both incoming and outgoing messages. This version is a modified "fork" of the widely known Chat Translator, updated to support the new Chat System (while still compatible with the old system) and ported to the latest Google Translation API. Remember, this is an ALPHA version, and it is not very user-friendly.

Requirements:
-setreadonly
-getrawmetatable
-checkcaller
-getnamecallmethod
-newcclosure

IMPORTANT: 
-If the script fails to load, check the console for common "missing channel/events" errors. If this occurs, it is most likely due to a custom chat system used by the game. (For more info use debugMode)
-This script does not technically perform the translations, so please do not complain to me about poor translation quality; direct those complaints to Google Translate.

Commands:
- `>set in/out on/off`: Toggles translation for Input/Output messages.
- `>in/out ISOCODE`: Sets the Input/Output language to the specified ISO code.

Supported ISO codes for languages are as follows (More will be added whenever I feel like typing a lot):  
`bg` (Bulgarian), `en` (English), `zh` (Chinese), `cz` (Czech), `da` (Danish), `nl` (Dutch), `et` (Estonian), `fi` (Finnish), `fr` (French), `de` (German), `el-GR` (Greek), `hu` (Hungarian), `it` (Italian), `ja` (Japanese), `ko` (Korean), `lv` (Latvian), `lt` (Lithuanian), `nb` (Norwegian), `pt-BR` (Brazilian Portuguese), `pt` (Portuguese), `ro` (Romanian), `ru` (Russian), `sk` (Slovak), `sl` (Slovenian), `sp` (Spanish), `es` (Spanish), `sv-SE` (Swedish), and `tr` (Turkish).
